title: A test that holds a gate slot is not flaky under the suite's own -parallel 12
description: From gvc finding 45e76fc4 (3h0): TestAGateThatOutlivesItsReconcilerKeepsHoldingItsSlot fails intermittently under the suite's own -parallel 12. Flaky means a bug: reproduce it deterministically (load, or a controlled delay), find the race, fix it.
acceptance_criteria: The race is reproduced deterministically, fixed, and the test passes 50/50 under -parallel 12 with CPU load
